periods.summary: In the epilogue, Tsukikage is present with Kazamatsuri Group president Kozo Kazamatsuri at the destroyed Rebellion headquarters in the Alps, a site whose destruction has collapsed the old balance among League, Union and Rebellion. Rinna, Charlotte and Sara prepare to defend Kozo and Tsukikage when American PSYON troops arrive, but Kozo orders them to stop because Abraham Carter is too strong. Abraham lands before Tsukikage and Kozo, names them, and asks whether they will be enemies or allies of the United States/world justice and which side they belong to. The volume ends before Tsukikage answers.

key_events.summary: Is confronted by Abraham Carter at ruined Rebellion HQ.
